newsitem.title: USA: Ashland Coal resumes merger talks with Arch.
newsitem.headline: Ashland Coal resumes merger talks with Arch.

text.p: Ashland Coal Inc and Arch Mineral Corp said on Monday that they planned to resume discussions of possible options for combining the two coal companies.
The companies said in a statement there were no assurances that the renewed discussions would lead to any combination.
The companies discussed merger possibilities in previous years, without success, the statement said.
Ashland Coal is a Huntington, West Virginia-based producer and marketer of low-sulfur steam coal primarily for the electrical generating industry.
Arch Mineral is a St. Louis-based producer, marketer and transporter of bituminous coal in the domestic and export steam and metallurgical coal markets.
